notes.title: Bug Fixes and Enhanced AI to Challenge Your Stealth Skills!
notes.content:
Hello Raiders!

We’re excited to bring you an update that not only fixes some pesky bugs but also introduces an enhanced AI system! This means enemy guards are now sharper, making your stealth skills even more critical for survival.

Here’s what’s new in this update:

Enhanced AI System: Enemy guards are now more aware, adapting to your movements and using smarter tactics to catch you. Are you up for the challenge?

Bug Fixes: We’ve addressed some issues to make gameplay smoother and more stable, ensuring a more immersive experience.

We hope you enjoy the heightened challenge and improved gameplay. As always, thank you for your feedback, and keep sharing your thoughts in the community forum!

Happy stealthing, and good luck out there! 🕶️⚔️

notes.title: Bug Fix Update - No More Falling Through!
notes.content:
Hey Raiders!

We’ve just released a small but important bug fix for Stealth Raider. Some players reported falling through the environment under specific circumstances, so we’ve patched things up to keep you safe and focused on the adventure!

Here’s what’s fixed in this update:

Resolved Falling Issue: Players will no longer fall through the environment. Now, you can explore each level with confidence!
Improved Stability: We’ve also made minor improvements to enhance the overall stability of the game.
Thank you for your feedback and support. If you encounter any other issues, please let us know in the community forum!

Happy raiding, and enjoy the smoother experience! 🏆

notes.title: Achievements Unlocked! Start Collecting Them Now!
notes.content:
Hello Raiders!

We’re thrilled to announce the introduction of Steam Achievements in Stealth Raider! 🎉 Whether you’re a stealth master or treasure hunter, there’s now a new way to prove your skills. Start your journey to unlock them all and showcase your progress to the world!

Here’s what’s included in this update:

Steam Achievements: unique achievements based on performance, exploration, and special challenges.
Compete with Friends: Track your achievements and see how you stack up against your friends.
More Coming Soon: This is just the beginning! We plan to release new achievements with future updates, adding more depth and challenges for you to conquer.
Thank you for your ongoing support! We can’t wait to see how many of you can earn them all. 🏆

Happy raiding! ⚔️

notes.title: Leaderboards Are Here! Compete for the Top Spot!
notes.content:
Attention Raiders!

With our latest update, we’re thrilled to introduce Steam Leaderboards for every level of Stealth Raider. Now, you can see how your skills stack up against other players and fight your way to the #1 position! 💪✨

Here’s what you can look forward to:

Each level now has its own leaderboard, so you can try to beat the best times and highest scores.
Track Your Progress: S[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193032/aeaeda8251a5eeb597ad5854190921c672fceab6.png[/img]en your skills and climb to the top.
Challenge Friends: Compete not just globally but with your friends to see who truly masters the art of stealth!
So, get ready to raid those dungeons and show off your skills! Can you claim the top spot? 🏆

Thank you for your continued support. Your journey as the ultimate Raider is just beginning!

notes.title: Version 1.0.2.1 - Bug Fix Update
notes.content:
Hello Raiders!

We're excited to announce the release of version 1.0.2.1. This update includes several small bug fixes to improve gameplay stability and enhance your experience. We've been working hard to address community-reported issues and make the game even smoother.

Thank you for your continued support! As always, if you encounter any issues, feel free to reach out through the community hub.

Happy raiding! 🏴‍☠️

notes.title: Stealth Raider
notes.content: Are you ready to uncover ancient treasures in the depths of dark dungeons? 🏺✨ Master stealth, evade traps, and grab riches beyond imagination in Stealth Raider. Add the game to your wishlist now and get ready for the ultimate stealth-action adventure!
